summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Hangman — A Modern Multiplayer Word Guessing Game, covering the faithful visual reproduction of the reference screenshots, all three gameplay modes (Computer, Pass and Play, and Authoritative WebSocket Online Multiplayer), the categorized word database, scoring engine, progressive sketch animations with toggleable audio, and the complete Python 3.11 + Flet + WebSockets + pytest modular codebase alongside the live playable preview.
